properties.value: Transitive toolchain dependency: hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations available to anything the dev/test toolchain runs. Kept as dependency inventory — presence is the question here, use is a finding question.

properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: SHA-1 available to the test toolchain; collision-broken, flagged CWE-328 downstream.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is the curve behind every Ethereum account and transaction in this toolchain (ethers, web3, hardhat, ganache). First-party signing happens through wrappers at utils/test_deployment.js (reported as its own finding). The curve itself is fixed by Ethereum consensus: observable here, replaceable only ecosystem-wide, not in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey@1.0.x pinned in package-lock.json — transitive dependency of the browserify/crypto-browserify shim stack used by the web3/truffle toolchain. Ships OpenSSL's EVP_BytesToKey single-iteration MD5-based KDF. No first-party call site in this repo; presence records what the build environment ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (OpenBSD bcrypt_pbkdf KDF, the bcrypt variant used for ssh key derivation; depends on tweetnacl ^0.14.3) pinned in the lockfile as a transitive dependency. No first-party call site in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: create-ecdh@4.0.0 (ECDH key agreement via elliptic, part of the crypto-browserify crypto shim) pinned in the lockfile as a transitive dependency of the web3/truffle toolchain. Classical ECDH capability ships in the tree; no first-party call site in this repo. Changeable only by upgrading the upstream dependency chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Ed25519 signature capability of tweetnacl@1.0.3, present via @metamask/eth-sig-util@4.0.1 (transitive). Available in the shipped library; no first-party call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is the EVM-standard hash, so its exposure is Grover-only (preimage/collision strength halved in theory, no Shor break). It is load-bearing here: the leaves and internal node hashes feed the merkle root that authorizes the on-chain StakingRewardsClaim airdrop.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry for the password KDF in the Ethereum toolchain; no PBKDF2 parameters are set by this repo, so iteration counts are whatever the downstream libraries use.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@2.0.4/3.0.1 pinned in the lockfile — the scrypt password KDF used for Ethereum v3 keystore (web3 Secret Storage) encryption; transitive dep of web3-eth-accounts (via @truffle/interface-adapter) and the ethers stack. No first-party call site in this repo.

Available in the shipped library; no first-party AES call site in this repo.

Its primitives are tracked separately as Ed25519 (ALG-683d5cd2), X25519 (ALG-defedad1) and XSalsa20-Poly1305 (ALG-f58a8f00). No first-party call site in this repo.
